info.name: KHR_CAMERA_DEPTH_OF_FIELD
info.comment: Local copy of the ANARI registry extension. The registry file attaches these parameters to an ANARI_CAMERA named 'default', which the query codegen would append as a bogus 'default' camera subtype; instead they are declared here on the camera subtypes this device actually exposes. Keep info.name equal to the official extension name so introspection still advertises it.
